newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL INDUSTRY SALES UP 5.9 PCT IN JUNE - CNI.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL INDUSTRY SALES UP 5.9 PCT IN JUNE - CNI.

text.p: Brazilian industry sales rose a seasonally-adjusted 5.9 percent in June versus May, the private National Industry Confederation said Thursday.
In real terms, not including seasonal factors, sales rose 2.2 percent in June from the previous month, the CNI said in a statement.
Sales growth in real terms in the first half of the year was 10.2 percent compared with the same period of last year.
Real sales in June were 15.4 percent higher than in June last year, the CNI said.
The CNI said its sales data "suggested that the growth in industrial activity has been shifting from the consumer goods sector to investment goods (capital goods)".
The body also said June's increase had been expected after a drop in industry sales in May, which itself followed a sharp rise in April.
In June the number of peopole employed in industry remained virtually stable, falling 0.08 percent, while the number of hours worked rose 4.23 percent, seasonally-adjusted.
Industry was working at 78.8 percent of total capacity in June, unchanged from May.
